def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    # Detect the repeated displacement between markers, then continue it.
    points.sort()
    if len(points) >= 2:
        dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
        dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
        if all((b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]) == (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
            r, c = points[-1]
            while r + dr < len(out) and c + dc < len(out[0]):
                r += dr
                c += dc
                out[r][c] = 2
        else:
            # Irregularly spaced marks: fill the next aligned continuation only.
            r, c = points[-1]
            step = max(1, min(dr, dc))
            while r + step < len(out) and c + step < len(out[0]):
                r += step
                c += step
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
